# WideScope — LLM Trace Viewer
===============================

WideScope is a browser-native, zero-backend trace viewer for LLM and AI agent pipelines.
It loads OTLP, Jaeger, or OpenInference JSON traces and provides instant inspection — 
all data stays in the browser. Powered by Rust/WASM and Svelte 5.

## What it does

WideScope takes distributed trace JSON files (from OpenTelemetry collectors, Jaeger backends,
or OpenInference exporters) and renders them as interactive visualizations in the browser.
No data is uploaded. No backend server exists. The entire analysis pipeline —
parsing, normalization, LLM attribute resolution, layout computation, search — runs in
Rust compiled to WebAssembly at client-side.

## Key capabilities

- Zero backend: static UI + WASM, deployed to Cloudflare Pages
- Five trace views: flame graph, timeline, waterfall, service graph, trace diff
- LLM-aware inspection: resolves OTel GenAI, OpenInference, and LangChain attributes
  into model name, token counts, prompt/completion content, tool calls, and cost estimates
- Multi-format parsing: OTLP JSON (resourceSpans), Jaeger JSON (data[].spans), OpenInference JSON (spans)
- Search with operators: duration>100ms, status=error, service~api, llm
- Span filtering: by status, service, kind, LLM-spans-only
- Critical path analysis, P50/P95 latency, cost breakdown
- Multi-trace loading: zip uploads, file picker, drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, JSON editor
- Trace diff: side-by-side comparison of two traces
- Span annotations, trace slicing, latency heatmap
- Self-contained share links: DEFLATE-compressed + seed dictionary for small traces
- Embed mode for external tool integration (?embed=1)
- Dark/light theme, keyboard shortcuts, accessible navigation

## Supported input formats

| Format | Key field | Status |
|---|---|---|
| OTLP JSON | resourceSpans | Fully supported |
| Jaeger JSON | data[].spans | Fully supported |
| OpenInference JSON | spans | Fully supported |

## LLM convention mappings

Three convention files are bundled at build time to normalize LLM attributes across formats:
- opentelemetry.json: OTel GenAI semconv (gen_ai.*)
- openinference.json: OpenInference attributes (llm.*, openinference.span.kind)
- langchain.json: LangChain attributes (langchain.*)

Resolution is first-match-wins across all three files.

## Architecture

The app has two parts:
1. crates/widescope-core/: Rust library compiled to WASM via wasm-pack. Handles parsing,
   convention resolution, layout computation, search, and analytics.
2. ui/: Svelte 5 + Vite app with canvas-based flame graph, SVG timeline, waterfall view,
   service graph (Cytoscape.js), and span detail sidebar.
